coverage: Fourteen governorates, 62 districts and 272 subdistricts from the retained UNCS/OCHA reference valid December 2020. Governorate populations are the explicitly dated 2004 resident census worksheet, not the separate civil-registration table. These historical counts do not estimate subsequent displacement. Administrative boundaries do not describe current territorial control. Country overviews stay hidden. Shared administrative edges and land frontiers have strokes; coastline and open water do not.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
